# Shreekamalinee (shreekamalinee.com)
> Royal Indian Heritage Handloom Sarees, Bridal Weaves & Artisanal Fashion

## About Shreekamalinee
Shreekamalinee is a premier luxury Indian ethnic fashion house and direct-from-artisan e-commerce brand based in Maharashtra, India. We specialize in authentic handwoven heritage sarees, traditional Maharashtrian attire, unstitched suit materials, royal bridal couture, and handcrafted accessories.

Every garment at Shreekamalinee is crafted by master handloom weavers using age-old hand-weaving techniques, pure mulberry silk, zari threads, and natural vegetable dyes.

- **Website:** https://shreekamalinee.com
- **Origin / Headquarters:** Maharashtra, India
- **Key Promise:** 100% Handloom Authenticity, Direct Weaver Fair Trade, Free Shipping Across India, Cash on Delivery (COD) Available.

---

## Core Product Collections

### 1. Paithani Sarees (Maharashtra's Royal Crown)
- **Pure Silk Paithani:** Handwoven in Yeola and Paithan with pure silk warp and weft, featuring intricate peacock (Mor), parrot (Popat), lotus (Kamal), and munia borders in pure gold/silver zari.
- **Semi-Paithani Sarees:** Light-weight festive and wedding sarees blending traditional motifs with contemporary draping ease.
- **Bridal Maharani Paithani:** Heavy zari pallu masterpieces designed for wedding celebrations and heirloom collections.

### 2. Maheshwari & Chanderi Weaves
- Handcrafted silk-cotton and pure silk sarees from the historic looms of Madhya Pradesh, known for reversible borders (Bugdi), checks, and lightweight royal sheen.

### 3. Ikat & Hand-Block Print Collections
- Authentic Pochampally and Sambalpuri double ikat sarees with geometric motifs.
- Ajrakh and Bagru natural dye hand-block prints on modal silk and pure cotton.

### 4. Readymade & Unstitched Dress Materials
- Pure cotton and silk unstitched suit fabrics with hand-embroidered dupattas.
- Contemporary ethnic one-pieces, kurtis, and festive coord sets.

### 5. Royal Accessories & Clutches
- Handcrafted Paithani silk clutches, Potli bags, and traditional jewelry accessories.

---

## Customer Experience & Policies

- **Delivery:** Express insured delivery across all pin codes in India. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days.
- **Payment Options:** UPI, Net Banking, Credit/Debit Cards, Cash on Delivery (COD with automated verification).
- **Quality Assurance:** Every handloom saree undergoes rigorous 5-point quality inspection and includes authentic care instructions.
- **Returns & Exchanges:** Hassle-free 7-day return/replacement window for unwashed, tag-intact items.
- **Concierge Styling:** Dedicated 1-on-1 Saree Styling Concierge via WhatsApp (+91 8329683648) for draping advice, video shopping, and blouse stitching customization.
